name: Shared Error Handler - Sanitized Logging & Alerting

parameters.content:
## Shared Error Handler

Every workflow in this portfolio sets **Settings → Error workflow** to this workflow (`errorWorkflow` in each workflow.json).

1. **Error Trigger** fires on any failed execution
2. **Sanitize & Classify** redacts secrets and PII, assigns severity
3. **Log Error** appends every failure to the Errors sheet (audit trail)
4. **High severity?** pages the team in Slack; low/medium are log-only

Node-level retries (3 tries, 2 s apart) absorb transient API failures before this workflow is ever triggered.
